prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1162; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Initial examination revealed effusion and tenderness along the medial joint line with limited flexion. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and no acute bony abnormality was identified. Clinical findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury involving the medial collateral ligament and meniscus.

Conservative management was initiated, including rest, activity modification, anti-inflammatory medication, and a structured physical therapy program focusing on quadriceps strengthening, gait normalization, and progressive range-of-motion exercises. The patient completed a total of 22 visits over the course of treatment. Pain and swelling improved steadily, and functional tolerance for walking and stair climbing increased with each phase of rehabilitation.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient demonstrated near-full knee flexion, minimal residual effusion, and improved strength. Some intermittent discomfort with prolonged kneeling persists. Continued home exercise and activity monitoring are recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of mechanical symptoms.
